slides.headline: Hand off any task without explaining it twice.
slides.badge_text: steps to a brief that works.

slides.label: THE MISTAKE
slides.wrong_sub: No goal, no limits, no idea what 'done' is.
slides.right:
A clear brief:
goal, done, limits.

slides.label: Step 1
slides.title: Goal and why
slides.card: I need [task] so that [result]. The reader is [who]. Ask me what's unclear.
slides.note: Remove client names before you paste.

slides.label: Step 2
slides.title: Define done
slides.card: Describe what a great result looks like in 3 bullets. Add one example I can share.

slides.label: Step 3
slides.title: Set the limits
slides.card: List the limits: deadline, budget, tools to use and things they must not do.

slides.label: Step 4
slides.title: Find the gaps
slides.card: Read my brief. What would a stranger still ask? List the gaps, then fix the brief.

slides.label: Step 5
slides.title: One check-in
slides.card: Suggest one check-in point halfway, and what I should look at when we meet.
slides.note: Read the brief yourself before you send it.

slides.headline: Save this for your next handoff.

scenes.headline: Never start a deck from a blank slide.
scenes.sub: Let AI draft it. You fix it.

scenes.title: Tell the tool 3 things
scenes.footer: Tools like Gamma draft the deck.

scenes.label: COPY THIS
scenes.text: Make a 10-slide deck for a freelance designer pitching a 3-month retainer to a small agency. Goal: they say yes to a call. Show the outline first and ask me what's missing.
